::: {#rem-mutual-information-venn}
#### Entropies as areas

The identities above match a picture of two overlapping regions,
with the area of one region standing for $\entropyf{X}$ and the area of the other for $\entropyf{Y}$.
The overlap has area $\mutinfof{X}{Y}$ (@def-mutual-information).
The part of the first region outside the overlap has area $\entropyf{X \mid Y}$,
and the part of the second region outside the overlap has area $\entropyf{Y \mid X}$.
The two regions together have area $\entropyf{X, Y}$
(@thm-mutual-information-joint-minus-conditionals).
The picture is a mnemonic for two variables only.

:::
